summary: Add a new slash command /log-tension to .claude/commands/ that captures a named two-source conflict directly into brewmind-open-loops.md.
rationale: Section G of the companion contract requires recording tensions when two sources disagree, using a defined Tension: pattern. The current setup has no slash command for this — users must manually edit brewmind-open-loops.md, remember the exact pattern, and know which section to write to. In practice this friction means tensions go unrecorded. A dedicated /log-tension command would reduce the action to a single invocation: pass the two source names and their conflicting claims, and the command writes the formatted Tension: entry to the correct section of brewmind-open-loops.md and echoes the result. This turns a multi-step manual task into a one-liner, directly enforcing the behavioral contract that requires tensions to be recorded not silently resolved.
proposed_diff_summary: Create .claude/commands/log-tension.md with frontmatter name=log-tension, argument-hint '<source-1> vs <source-2>: <claim-1> / <claim-2> [domain]'. Steps: (1) read brewmind-open-loops.md, (2) identify the correct domain section, (3) append a formatted Tension: entry with today's date, both sources, both claims, and a placeholder resolution path, (4) echo the written entry to Xavier and note it as a DOCSYNC action.
